headline: TMT Law Practice advises Yash Raj Films on investment in Rusk Media
sum: Yash Raj Films Private Limited has made a strategic investment in Rusk Media Private Limited. TMT Law Practice advised YRF on this investment.
detail: Yash Raj Films Private Limited has made a strategic investment in Rusk Media Private Limited. TMT Law Practice advised YRF on this investment. The Firm advised on structuring, diligence and documentation of the transaction. The transaction was led by Rajeev Parashar (Partner), with support from Alaqshendra Singh (Associate Partner) and Gaurav Pandey (Senior Associate).
